latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Group Photo Generator OpenAPI skill.
- Supports creating creative group photos or collages from up to 10 images.
- Allows optional custom style instructions and batch generation (1–16 images).
- Requires a WESHOP_API_KEY for authentication; only send to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Includes endpoints for starting runs, polling status, and image uploads.
